summary: Jaguar Health, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose amendments to existing royalty interest agreements and a secured promissory note. On June 17, 2026, Jaguar amended its Uptown 2020 Royalty Interest with Uptown Capital, LLC, setting monthly payments starting October 1, 2026 at the greater of $750,000 or the actual royalty amount. Simultaneously, it amended the Streeterville 2022 Royalty Interest with Streeterville Capital, LLC, deferring payment start from July 1 to October 1, 2026, with the same $750,000 minimum. The 2021 Note with Streeterville had its maturity extended from July 1 to October 1, 2026. No specific terms beyond payment mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine financing modification, not a special situation.
